translation: Sixteen: The head is level and the crown soft; everything is nearly complete. Suddenly the upper tooth on the left side ached; I knew it was a disease of the foot yangming channel. I rubbed the outer bridge of the nose and pushed back its inside; on the left side there was a sheet of accumulation inserted into the root of the nose. Rubbing it made a sound, clear nasal discharge flowed straight out, and the pain also stopped somewhat.
